data.title: Gym & Franchise Success Stories | TrainZilla

data.keywords: gym franchise success stories, multi-location gym management software, per-location revenue dashboard, franchise gym software, coaching business growth

_rationale: Old copy was broad ('personal trainers, online coaches and studios') with no franchise/multi-location angle, even though this page is the natural proof point for a gym-ops buyer doing comparison research.
